subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor an in-product preset gallery and Custom Theme Studio with broader persistence?
rationale: The current product/docs surface intentionally exposes a narrower import model, while this issue asks for a larger authoring and persistence surface that automation should not choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Define a narrow theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide which preset, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Stay with tweakcn import
options.body: Treat the existing external editor plus one local import slot as the supported customization path and narrow or close the broader in-product studio request later.

options.title: Split staged work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessible presets, and per-variable local editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide which preset, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the issue and authored the current tweakcn customization path that this request would expand or replace.
